evaluate_code_correctness: run code correctness evaluation on a JSONL file of code generation trajectories and print best-of-k metrics
evaluate_code_with_preference_pairs: evaluate code trajectories and save chosen-rejected preference pairs to a JSONL file for RL training
evaluate_code_with_ground_truth: evaluate code trajectories and save preference pairs annotated with ground truth answers to a file
reevaluate_code_rewards: reevaluate code correctness rewards for trajectories missing reward values and overwrite the JSONL file
compute_best_of_k_correctness: compute best-of-k average correctness and percentage of correct trajectories from repeated code generation runs
